name: dsh-px
description: dsh-px: a self-contained Electron desktop client that packages DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into one app.
author: Palbudir

scripts.build: npm run build:plugins && npm run build:main
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.//build:plugins: 自研插件的两个半边都是**预构建产物**（lib/index.js、lib/client.js），入库交付。宿主半边先构建：它决定 lib/ 是否完整。
scripts.test: npm run build:plugins && esbuild test/**/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=build-test --log-level=warning && node --test build-test/*.test.js
scripts.//scripts: scripts/*.ts 是源码，by scripts/run.mjs 编译到 build-scripts/ 后运行 —— 不用 Node 的 .ts 原生支持（实验特性，CI 上不该依赖）。
scripts.//screenshot: 用 Playwright 驱动 Electron 截图，做「界面是否正常」的视觉验证（截图落在 build/screenshots/）。首次需 npm run build。
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/run.mjs write-app-update-yml
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prune && electron-builder --publish never && npm run verify:package
scripts.format: prettier --write packages scripts/plugins scripts/build-plugins.mjs scripts/check-plugins.mjs scripts/dev.mjs config/plugins.json test/quality-review.test.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages scripts/plugins scripts/build-plugins.mjs scripts/check-plugins.mjs scripts/dev.mjs config/plugins.json test/quality-review.test.ts
scripts.check:repo: npm run check:plugins && npm run format:check
